svg.title: Recent catalog cohorts lose usable EUR price coverage
svg.text: Recent catalog cohorts lose usable EUR price coverage
Question: which brand-years support a price comparison? Cells show usable / catalog models.
n=1,625 current catalog IDs; Android; 2010-2025 announcement cohorts; EUR. Grey = no catalog models; * = passes coverage rule.
Numeric flags: ok, unit_converted, unusual_low, unusual_high. OS: mapped; year: ok. Catalog amounts, not verified launch MSRP.
Rule: catalog n >= 20; usable prices >= 10; usable EUR / catalog >= 50%.
Announcement year (calendar cohort; no timestamp/timezone conversion)
